IS 15902 : 2010 : Guidelines For Nursing HomeICS 91.040.10MHD 14Reaffirmed 20201. ScopeThis standard covers basic requirements for planning a nursing home in respect of functional, space, man power, instruments and equipment, and management requirements. Certain essential requirements for building, services and environment have also been included.2. ReferencesThe following standards contain provisions which through references in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
